_comment: Source of truth for the Starter Pack catalog. The builder computes symbols/size/version per pack at build time; only id/name/description/free/repos are authored here. repos use GitHub owner/name slugs (also the jcm repo_id).
_licence_comment: Every packed repo is third-party OSS and nine of ten packs are sold, so each pack ships the upstream licence and attribution files VERBATIM. `spdx` here is a TRIPWIRE, not the source of truth: the builder copies whatever files the clone actually has and fails the pack when their bytes change, so a relicensing upstream stops the build instead of shipping quietly. Verified against each repo 2026-07-31; two came back NOASSERTION from GitHub's own detector and are noted below.

nodejs/node.note: LICENSE is a 157 KB compendium, not a plain MIT file: MIT for Node itself followed by the licences of every bundled dependency (V8, ICU, OpenSSL, zlib and others). GitHub reports NOASSERTION. Ship it whole; never summarise it as MIT.

koajs/koa.note: LICENSE plus an AUTHORS file that the copyright line depends on.

django/django.note: Ships LICENSE, LICENSE.python (PSF, for vendored CPython code) and AUTHORS, which the BSD copyright line refers to. All three travel.

pallets/flask.note: Licence file is LICENSE.txt, not LICENSE.

spring-projects/spring-boot.note: Apache-2.0 also obliges us to carry a NOTICE file where one exists and to state changes. There is no NOTICE at the repo root as of 2026-07-31, and we make no modifications, so LICENSE.txt alone discharges it. Re-check if a NOTICE appears.

modelcontextprotocol/typescript-sdk.note: Mid-relicensing: new contributions are Apache-2.0, contributions whose authors have not consented stay MIT, documentation is CC-BY-4.0. GitHub reports NOASSERTION. Re-check when the transition completes; the sha tripwire will fire when it does.
